title: SG-5.6.2 Scene unit tests with Phaser mocked cover the scene behaviors through the @game alias
summary: Confirm scene unit tests, with Phaser mocked, cover layer ordering, content-to-entity creation, visibility conditions, hover and click, and the missing-asset fallback, importing real source through @game and passing together.
description: Context: game/tests has scene tests (layers, buildScene, sceneObject, interaction, preload) that import source with relative paths. game/vitest.config.ts defines the @game and phaser aliases, but game/tsconfig.json has no @game path mapping. Desired behavior: a scene suite imports real, existing source through @game, mocks Phaser, covers the five behaviors and passes together. Expected result: one command runs the suite green, and tsc resolves @game. Why: the sub-goal SG-5.6.2 needs proof that the scene behaviors are tested against real files.
acceptance_criteria: Given the game tsconfig, when tsc resolves '@game/engine/layers', then it maps to game/src/engine/layers.ts
Given the scene suite files, when they run together under vitest, then every test passes with Phaser mocked
Given the suite, when its imports are read, then every source import uses the @game alias and names an existing file
Given the suite, when it runs, then it asserts layer ordering, content-to-entity creation, visibility conditions, hover and click, and the missing-asset fallback

preserve: public APIs of src/engine and src/entities

technical_constraints: Phaser must be mocked in tests
Tests import real source via @game, not mocks of it
definition_of_done: All three requirements have Act and Verify units done
